findings.issue: Acceptance scenario 9 says the three constructors are called once each. No test checks this. wireDemoPipeline (main.go:451) does call each constructor once, so the code is correct, but nothing would catch a regression. Separately, scenario 2 says the last four tools in tools/list follow the R2 order. TestDemoPipelineFlagOnAddsFourTools sorts the names before comparing, so the order is only checked at registry level, in TestDemoToolsOrder.
findings.fix: Optional: check that a second buildServer call does not share service instances. Or state in the PR that the call-once property is guaranteed by inspecting wireDemoPipeline. Note in the PR that the order is asserted on the registry because tools/list ordering is up to the SDK.

findings.issue: The output structs confirmChangeSetOutput and confirmSectionTextOutput (section_text.go:66) have no Status field. L1 R12 and L3 R9 both return a Result whose Status is completed, partial, reconciliation_required or mismatch. The schema does allow `status` through commonStructuredOutputProperties, as the plan intends, so the schema is final. The Go output type is not.
findings.fix: Add `Status string `json:"status,omitempty"`` to both output structs so the lanes fill the field instead of changing the type. The lanes may also do this, since they own these files.

findings.issue: The contract comment on changeset.New mentions NL_DEMO_SECTIONS_DIR. That variable belongs to the L2 section recipe loader and has nothing to do with the change set service, so the comment could mislead the L1 lane.
findings.fix: Reword it to say New must succeed in demo mode with the flag on and no extra fixtures, so the L0 flag-on server tests stay green.
